historical_reviews.deepseek: The broad Locate idea matches the indicator but unsafe generic syntax cannot prove exact-target or cleanup coverage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds target identity, operator observation, non-target exclusion and per-drive start/clear traceability.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Present, Access/Busy, RAID-fail and Rebuild are different indicator states and may not substitute for Locate/UID.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Each approved target receives one exact start/read/visual/clear transaction and must be cleared before moving on.

original_test_intent: Verify the supported Locate/UID function for each mapped NVMe SSD illuminates the correct physical bay and returns to idle after clearing.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts/observes each mapped SSD while the agent executes only the pinned target-specific vendor start/read/clear sequence and records health/log evidence.
manual_activity: Engineer resolves hardware scope and approves mapping/tool; qualified operator inserts and observes every target; agent performs one exact start/read/clear cycle per SSD.
required_inputs: Decision on SAS/SATA identity versus literal NVMe Locate scope
Per-drive Locate/UID state, cadence, timing and clear specification
Pinned vendor interface/version and exact target syntax
Supported insertion/data recovery, qualified operator, camera and OOB
safety_requirements: Revalidate stable identity and physical label before each command
Confirm Locate semantics and observe adjacent/non-target bays
Clear the same target and verify idle before the next drive
Stop on wrong/multiple LEDs, ambiguous selector, failed clear, storage/thermal/power/BMC error or access loss
Do not use raw IPMI, guessed IDs or locate-all
agent_execution_scope: Capture per-drive baseline mapping and health
Record output, timing, operator target/non-target evidence and final all-clear
Do not handle hardware, infer visual state, recover blindly or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve scope and approve mapping, tool, LED matrix and recovery
Provide operator and own wrong-target/failed-clear recovery
Review every drive independently and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic Locate broadly matches purpose, but raw commands and unspecified selectors cannot prove exact NVMe target or final clear state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a pinned documented controller/BMC interface with stable per-drive selectors for start/readback/clear, synchronized with target and adjacent-bay photos.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVMe insertion, adapter selection, Locate check, system-spec Criteria and source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute independent baseline/start/clear transactions for each SSD and prove target exclusivity plus no residual Locate state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure identity, per-drive cleanup and evidence without changing the Locate trigger.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation controls the state; qualified physical observation remains mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Controller/enclosure numbering may not equal chassis labels and can change after service.

project_override_considerations: Project authority must resolve SAS/SATA versus NVMe taxonomy and select the exact supported SES, NVMe-MI, RAID CLI, Redfish or BMC interface; targets are not interchangeable by assumption.
expected_evidence: Scope decision and per-drive Locate/UID matrix
Pinned tool/version and stable identity/slot mapping
Operator insertion and target/non-target photos per drive
Exact start/readback/clear output, status and timestamps
Complete controller/RAID/mount/NVMe health and OS/BMC logs
Final all-clear/restored state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: SAS/SATA grouping conflicts with the explicit NVMe SSD and NVMe-adapter procedure; the authoritative device-family scope requires engineering decision although Locate intent is consistent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Scope, mapping, vendor command and operator are supplyable inputs; static review is complete and later cases may continue.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row117 Wistron-Storage-00100-V003: decide whether the authoritative Locate/UID coverage is NVMe despite SAS/SATA grouping, SAS/SATA, or separate variants; provide per-drive serial/adapter/controller/enclosure/slot map, platform LED semantics and pinned target-specific start/readback/clear syntax. Raw IPMI, guessed selectors or uncleared indicators are not acceptable.

review_improvement: Turns a generic unsafe Locate suggestion into secure per-drive exact-target transactions and exposes the unresolved hardware-family identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: A command success only proves a selector was accepted, not which physical bay illuminated. Because enclosure numbering can drift and stale Locate state can misdirect service, stable identity, physical target/non-target observation and explicit same-target clearing are necessary for every drive.
